headline: Reliability-focused validation of biomedical imaging and multimodal fusion models
label: Validated Biomedical Measurement Pipelines
summary: Biomedical models increasingly need calibrated uncertainty and deployment-aware evaluation beyond single development datasets.
synthesis: The dominant thread is how biomedical model performance and uncertainty are assessed for reliability beyond a single development dataset. BMDS-Net evaluates multi-modal brain tumor MRI segmentation on BraTS 2021 with a deployment-aware design, adding adaptive fusion, decoder regularization, and Bayesian calibration to a two-stage Swin UNETR. Coracle provides conformal uncertainty for early, late, and intermediate multimodal fusion, with finite-sample coverage guarantees on biomedical data. The pathology preprint instead targets domain adaptation, using a latent diffusion model conditioned on foundation-model features to generate target-aware synthetic images for semi-supervised classification. The items differ in modality and method, so the shared element is not architecture but how reliability is established. What is new is the pairing of formal coverage guarantees with deployment-aware and calibration-focused evaluation as primary outputs.
